title: New draft invoice
purpose: Prepare an internal draft from this received chain of custody and an active price list or a matching accepted quote version.
summary: Prepare an internal draft from this received chain of custody and an active price list or a matching accepted quote version.

tasks.title: Prepare the draft
steps: Review [[Current received tests]], including the sample dispositions.
Choose a [[Price list]] covering every displayed test, or an [[Accepted quote version]] matching the received tests and quantities. Leave the other source blank.
Select [[Create draft invoice]], then review the copied billing details and USD amounts.

tasks.title: Resolve a missing price
steps: Read the missing-test message beside [[Price list]].
Choose another active list or record the missing prices in Price lists, then retry.

tasks.title: Use accepted quote prices
steps: Choose [[Accepted quote version]] for this client and project, or a quote without a project.
Match each test and its received quantity. Quoted fees and discounts copy once; extra or missing tests are refused.
Select [[Create draft invoice]] and check the retained quote reference and copied prices.

good_to_know: Every test must have a recorded price. Missing prices are never treated as zero.
The draft copies current billing details and prices when created. Later source changes do not update it.
Held and rejected samples can appear. Inclusion does not establish that their work is chargeable.
If this order already has an active draft, open that draft instead.
Quote quantities must match this order. Use on other orders is not tracked; billing details still come from the client and order.

sections.title: Access and purpose
paragraphs: Only project managers and administrators can open or change draft invoices. Other staff and client accounts are refused, including direct links. These are internal USD billing worksheets. They cannot be issued or paid and are not visible in the client portal. No tax, due date, payment or accounting entry is calculated.

items.label: Chain of custody / client / project
items.description: The source order and its client/project appear above the form; the order reference opens its record.

items.label: Price list
items.description: Optional active list, required when no accepted quote is selected. Current USD prices are read when creating the draft; list name and revision are saved. Every received test needs a price. Inactive lists are refused.

items.label: Accepted quote version
items.description: Optional alternative to Price list; select exactly one source. Search quote number or frozen issued title. Choices are accepted issued versions for the order client, limited to this project or quotes without a project; the version must match the recorded client acceptance. Options load 20 at a time, newest quote first. No choices means there is no eligible accepted version; use an active price list or finish the quote workflow. The full quote must contain one test line per definition, exactly matching all received test definitions and counts. Duplicate, missing and extra test lines are refused with a field error; there is no price-list fallback. Each quoted fee or discount copies once after the test lines, retaining its kind, description, quantity, signed price and source quote line. The valid-until date applies to acceptance; a previously accepted quote remains selectable after that date.

items.label: Current received tests
items.description: Lab ID, client sample ID, receipt disposition and requested test identify every current requested test on received samples. No planned but unreceived sample contributes a line.

items.label: Create draft invoice
items.description: Creates the billing snapshot, exact line amounts and attributed history together, then opens the draft. No tests, a cancelled order, more than 200 combined test, fee and discount lines, missing prices, negative or oversized totals or an existing active draft prevents creation. A concurrent source change requires reloading and review. Quote eligibility and full-order matching are checked again under locks before saving. Each source test gets quantity one and its quoted description/unit price. No cumulative quote usage or ledger is updated; quote terms and client reference do not replace order billing fields.

items.label: Client name / Account code
items.description: The client name is required, up to 160 characters; account code is optional, up to 40. Copied from the client at creation and editable on the draft. Editing these labels does not change the source order or its client relationship.

items.label: Invoice-to contact / Invoice email
items.description: Optional contact name, up to 160 characters, and a valid email address. Initially copied from the invoice contact and email; blank invoice values use the primary contact and email. Nothing is emailed.

items.label: Billing address
items.description: Initially the invoice address, or the client mailing address when blank. Optional text, up to 4000 characters when edited. Line breaks are preserved.

items.label: Payment terms
items.description: Optional: Due on receipt, Net 15 days, Net 30 days, Net 45 days, Net 60 days or Prepaid. Initially the client terms. Information only; no due date or payment is calculated.

items.label: Purchase order
items.description: Optional text up to 60 characters. Initially the order PO, or the project standing PO when the order has none. A missing PO is not a draft-creation gate.

sections.title: Source and history
paragraphs: The draft keeps its source chain of custody, project, sample identities, requested test identities, method/version, matrix, unit, disposition and selected price-list name/revision or accepted quote version, acceptance snapshot and source quote lines. Each current requested test on a received sample creates one line, initially quantity 1. Each fee or discount from an accepted quote creates one additional line with its original quantity and signed price, without a sample or test identity. Held, rejected and qualified samples are included with their disposition; the preparer decides whether work is chargeable. Later source corrections, withdrawn tests and price changes do not update the draft.

There can be one active draft per order and at most 200 combined test, fee and discount lines. Every source line and its kind are retained; lines cannot be added, removed or reassigned. Cancel a draft and create a replacement to take a new source snapshot. A cancelled draft and its history remain readable. Invoice billing data never changes custody, results or released reports.

items.label: Errors and concurrent changes
items.description: Errors appear above the form or beside the field, with submitted values preserved. A source or revision change requires reloading and reviewing the current record before retrying. No partial draft or audit event is saved on failure.

items.label: Cancel / Close form
items.description: Leave without saving. A dialog with changed input offers Keep editing or Discard changes. This ordinary Cancel action does not cancel an existing draft invoice.

items.label: Maximize / Restore size / Try again
items.description: Resize a dialog without saving, or retry a failed dialog load. On narrow screens the dialog uses the full screen. Wait for saving to finish before continuing.

items.label: Draft invoices / draft number
items.description: Breadcrumb links return to the directory or draft record without saving.
